purpose: Give a future authorised team one material-language reference and five blank, auditable handover templates for a bounded reversible exercise. The kit makes public clearance, human fallback, removal and close-out legible without asserting a site-specific build.
claim_boundary: This is not a construction drawing, bill of quantities, technical specification, accessibility certification, site survey, approval, procurement record, budget, named operator or installation commitment. No component may be installed, counted as available, or used to promote a Verified SLA until the applicable authorised records and professional reviews exist.

rights_and_method.author: Rainyy-Yan / Codex
rights_and_method.method: Participant-authored generative concept visualisation, paired with participant-authored structured templates. No reference photograph, map tile, logo, trademark, real-site image, proprietary component catalogue or external technical drawing was supplied to the generator.
rights_and_method.reuse_boundary: Proposal illustration and future handover aid only. The image and templates cannot evidence existing conditions, dimensions, material availability, accessibility performance, heritage compatibility, safety, permission or implementation approval.

concept_kit.conceptual_material_language: dark powder-coated frame with a pale fabric canopy
concept_kit.public_service_role: A reversible shade reservation outside the public clearway; it never substitutes for field-verified heat or shade performance.
concept_kit.close_out: Remove when clearance, maintenance, weather-safety or stop-authority conditions are absent.

concept_kit.conceptual_material_language: warm timber-faced bench or counter with lockable wheels
concept_kit.public_service_role: Offers a bounded pause or human enquiry surface without fixing a use, capacity or service period.
concept_kit.close_out: Remove or relocate when passage, publicness, maintenance or human fallback fails.

concept_kit.conceptual_material_language: matte yellow freestanding post with a replaceable blank information panel
concept_kit.public_service_role: Keeps basic orientation readable without a phone, screen, account or AI service.
concept_kit.close_out: Withdraw when content ownership, legibility, maintenance or public-path conditions are not current.

concept_kit.conceptual_material_language: low translucent panel with a stable dark base
concept_kit.public_service_role: Separates an authorised observation or test edge from the public clearway; it does not prove a safe test environment.
concept_kit.close_out: Stop and remove when an activity affects public passage, safety, access or the authorised test boundary.

concept_kit.conceptual_material_language: tactile sample surface and a small human-help counter
concept_kit.public_service_role: Makes the no-device route and the human decision point explicit; it is not an accessibility compliance detail.
concept_kit.close_out: Do not deploy or retain it without an authorised accessible-alternative review and a maintained human response route.

blank_handover_templates.future_owner: future authorised accountable and stop-authority roles
blank_handover_templates.rule: Blank, expired, missing or unauditable fields retain HOLD.

blank_handover_templates.name_zh: 公共清晰带与无设备路径核验表
blank_handover_templates.rule: This template may document only observed conditions and never promotes unknown to Verified by itself.
Any safety, access, privacy, bypass or stop-authority failure ends the exercise.

blank_handover_templates.name_zh: 停止、降级与改线决定记录
blank_handover_templates.name_en: stop, downgrade and reroute decision record
blank_handover_templates.future_owner: future authorised stop authority and reviewer
blank_handover_templates.rule: A stop decision has priority over a test, concept schedule or AI suggestion.

blank_handover_templates.future_owner: future accountable maintenance and close-out roles
blank_handover_templates.rule: An exercise is incomplete until the public edge is checked, components are removed or lawfully handed over, and unresolved risks are recorded.

activation_sequence: HND-02 public clearway and no-device route observed
HND-05 close-out and return to baseline
phase_boundary: Phase 0 requests and records evidence. Phase 1 is a permitted, limited, reversible exercise only. Phase 2 needs discipline-specific review. Phase 3 needs sustained responsibility, maintenance and independently auditable evidence. The visual kit changes none of those phase conditions.
